purpose: Independent moderate-width, medium-goal success instance calibrated from e012
calibration_basis: e012 showed that a 3.0 m corridor and 6.0 m goal exceeded a 30 s client window after one recovery; e013 changes the scenario instance and allocates a longer window rather than relabeling or rerunning e012.
inclusion_rule: Include only if simulator/capture quality gates pass, terminal status is succeeded, recovery history is complete, and zero unique recovery attempts are recorded.
mismatch_rule: Retain any valid artifact but classify as development calibration and do not relabel it into the intended family.
causal_limit: No blocker configuration is evaluator-only context and does not prove why Nav2 succeeds or which observations Nav2 consumed.
